content_rules._doc: Hard rules from docs/dev/character-briefs.md. Alluring fan-service up to the App Store 18+ limit; every character an ADULT (apparent age 20+, adult face, proportions and styling); suggestive but never explicit (no visible nipples, genitals or pubic area, including through sheer fabric; no sexual acts or poses mimicking them). tools/comfy/prompts.py refuses to send a prompt that breaks these.

consistency: One checkpoint, one family block, one style/composition block and fixed sampler settings for all 15 heroes (style consistency).
Fixed seeds per hero: candidates use seed_base + i; every candidate's seed, prompt, negative, model and settings are saved next to the image, so any candidate re-renders exactly.
After a master image is chosen, everything else derives from it (face polish, upscale, expression variants, fixes) through img2img/inpaint at low denoise. Never re-roll the master.
New poses or outfits for a hero: img2img from the master (denoise 0.5-0.6) and, if the server has ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus, --ref <master> to add an IPAdapter reference (weight 0.6-0.8).
Later: train a character LoRA per hero from 15-30 curated images (master + variants + refs) and list it in heroes.<id>.loras.
